about.title: About the Crown Zenith set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Crown Zenith is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 20 January 2023. It has 160 cards: 159 in the main set and 1 secret rare. There are also 112 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 159 main set cards), the Master set (271 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 272 cards, adding the 1 secret rare).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
